item.title: Kelissa Uncovers ‘The Good Side of Things’ on First Studio Album in Almost a Decade: ‘I Created the Music I Wanted and Needed’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We're excited to share with you the latest from reggae luminary Kelissa, who's just released her new album, "The Good Side of Things". It's been nine years since her debut album "Spellbound", and this new collection of tunes is all about finding the positive in life.
[Music clip: "Cut & Clear" by Kelissa plays in the background]
Host: Kelissa, who's the sister of Grammy winner Keznamdi and partner of Grammy-nominated reggae superstar Chronixx, has crafted an album that blends her roots reggae foundation with her love for world music and poetic lyrics. We caught up with her to talk about the new album, which features a diverse sound that she's carefully curated.
Kelissa (audio clip): "I really believe in curating a sound for albums; I don’t think it should just be a random collection of songs. Although this [album] has a very diverse sound, we worked very hard to create one sound — and that’s what took all this time."
Host: The album features tracks like "Jah Odo (Jah Love)" and a reimagined version of her mother's song "Trying". Kelissa's music is deeply rooted in her family legacy, as the daughter of reggae band Chakula's leaders, Errol "Jakmandora" McDonald and Kerida "Goldilocks" Scott.
[Music clip: "Jah Odo (Jah Love)" by Kelissa plays in the background]
Host: After taking time off to focus on family life, including the birth of her daughter with Chronixx, Kelissa is back in the spotlight and already thinking about her next album. Her latest project marks a new chapter in her music journey, one that's filled with optimism and faith.
Kelissa (audio clip): "I’ve been working! This process took years. We made a lot more music across different genres, but this combination of songs was what felt most needed right now. And making this music was such a healing process."
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Make sure to check out Kelissa's new album, "The Good Side of Things", and follow us for more music updates. Thanks for listening!
